post_game_reflections.self_assessment: Despite my leadership position, I failed to effectively utilize my team's skills and execute successful missions. I need to improve my strategic decision-making and adapt to unexpected role reveals. I also underestimated the impact of Eve as an evil member.

player_observations.Alice: I observed that our good teammate Diana worked effectively with my team and was a valuable ally. She understood how to use our combined skills to our advantage.
player_observations.Bob: Bob's (Merlin's) influence was barely noticeable, which led me to believe he was a loyal good member, but it later turned out to be a strategic move by the evil team to keep him hidden.
player_observations.Charlie: As my teammate, Charlie's Assassin role led to some unexpected betrayals, which severely impacted our mission success. He proved to be a cunning player, but I should have anticipated his true intentions.
player_observations.Diana: Diana, like Bob, kept a low profile and worked well within our group, often sacrificing her own goals for the greater good. Her dedication to our mission was admirable.
player_observations.Eve: Eve was a master of deception, cleverly hiding her true evil role until the end. Her manipulation of our team's dynamics and her successful evasions of suspicion led to some unexpected failures for our good team.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: Despite having the Merlin role which typically holds a lot of power in Avalon, I was unsuccessful in my attempts to uncover the traitors. I often found myself reacting to their moves rather than proactively taking control of the game. To improve, I should strive to make bolder moves and be more strategic in my decision-making.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played a relatively passive game for the first two missions, only to reveal herself as a loyal servant in the final reveal. Her ability to convincingly conceal her role until the end suggests she may have a strong understanding of the game and the ability to make difficult decisions to protect the team.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie, revealed as the Assassin, demonstrated exceptional cunning and patience throughout the game. His ability to evade suspicion and remain hidden until the final reveal indicates a high level of strategic thinking and skill in manipulating gameplay.
player_observations.Diana: Diana, another loyal servant, made solid contributions to the team and demonstrated good communication and decision-making skills. She effectively worked with Charlie and me to pass two of the missions before ultimately falling victim to Charlie's actions.
player_observations.Eve: Eve, revealed as the traitor, played her role convincingly and made a few key moves that swung the game in the direction of team evil. She was able to identify Diana's role and eliminate her, contributing heavily to the mission failures. Her strategic thinking and ability to adapt to changing circumstances were key factors in the traitors' victory.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I successfully completed my mission by winning the game without being discovered, leveraging my position in key discussions and manipulating the vote results to my advantage. However, I wish I had contributed more decisively in earlier votes, allowing Eve to cover for me more easily. Overall, my strategy paid off, but room exists for more direct influence.

player_observations.Alice: Alice's role was convincingly performed as a Good Person, as she seemed genuinely unaware of my character and played cautiously throughout the game.
player_observations.Bob: I was impressed by Bob's skillful handling of his Merlin role, as he managed to subtly influence key votes and maintain a convincing facade.
player_observations.Diana: Diana's character was somewhat one-dimensional, with her playing more reactively throughout the game, although she made a valuable contribution in her final vote.
player_observations.Eve: Eve played a solid Evil Role, effectively working with me to eliminate Good characters and ultimately contributing to our joint victory.
player_observations.Charlie: Ah, another game with an identical name as me - I suppose this Charlie's performance was less convincing than mine, as my true name and role remained undiscovered throughout.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I was too trusting of my teammates, especially in mission 3, and did not communicate effectively to counter the Assassin's influence. I should have been more cautious about revealing my identity and role at critical points during the game. In hindsight, I could have made more informed decisions about when to risk revealing my role.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played very strategically, often taking calculated risks to advance our mission objectives. Her ability to think critically and strategically helped the Evil team in mission 3.
player_observations.Bob: Bob's ability to read the game and stay under the radar was impressive. His decision to not take a strong stance on missions 1 and 2 helped the Evil team, making it harder for us to decipher his role.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie was the mastermind behind the Evil team, effectively manipulating the game from the beginning. His ability to deceive and eliminate other roles, particularly Merlin, was a key factor in the Evil team's victory.
player_observations.Eve: Eve played to her strengths as a loyal and cunning Evil player. She knew exactly when to strike and how to use her influence to disrupt our mission objectives.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I successfully manipulated the good and Merlin, effectively preventing them from succeeding in their missions. My ability to convincingly feign good intentions allowed me to gain trust among my teammates. However, in some instances, I may have been too subtle in my evil actions, leading to a couple of close calls.

player_observations.Alice: Alice played it too safe, often choosing to not take risks and follow a predictable approach. Her actions as a Good were somewhat predictable, and I was able to exploit this.
player_observations.Bob: Bob effectively played the role of Merlin, providing crucial support to the missions. He worked well with Diana, but his presence did not pose a significant threat to my plans.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie was a formidable Assassin, and his presence posed a significant threat to the team's missions. However, I was able to manipulate him into failing his missions by pretending to be on his side.
player_observations.Diana: Diana played the role of Good somewhat inconsistently, sometimes being too cautious and other times being too aggressive. This inconsistency made it challenging for her to effectively work with Charlie.
